title: Agent evaluation in Copilot Studio: how agents are tested, what the tests cost and who can limit them
summary: The documented evaluation workflow, billing distinctions and governance controls are supported. The page correctly reports Microsoft's conflicting connector guidance and leaves the per-agent limit API unconfirmed. Add the product overview as a source for evaluation before and after publication.

claims.claim: Agent evaluation automatically tests an agent against test questions and scores each test case.
claims.quote: Copilot Studio sends the questions in the test cases, records the agent's responses, compares those responses against expected responses or a standard of quality, and assigns a score to each test case.

claims.claim: Administrators can allocate the environment credits used by Microsoft Copilot harness evaluation.
claims.quote: Administrators can allocate credits to environments and monitor usage to ensure that sufficient credits are available.

claims.claim: The data policy blocking route is Security > Data and privacy > Data policy > policy > Edit Policy > Add an environment > Assign connectors > connector > three dots > Block.
claims.quote: select the data policy and select Edit Policy. ... The Add an environment page appears. ... The Assign connectors page appears. ... Select the three dots (⋮) next to the connector ... select Block.

claims.claim: Add-ConnectorsToPolicy accepts PolicyName, Classification and Connectors to move connectors into a policy group.
claims.quote:
Add-ConnectorsToPolicy
    [-PolicyName] <String>
    [-Classification] <String>
    [-Connectors] <Object[]>

claims.where: controls[0].note; Risks and limits: data policy; summary
claims.claim: Copilot Studio's data policy documentation says blocking the Microsoft Copilot Studio connector prevents authenticated evaluations.
claims.quote: To prevent agent makers from adding event triggers to their agents or running automated evaluations by using an authenticated account, configure a data policy that blocks the Microsoft Copilot Studio connector.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Risks and limits: data policy
claims.claim: Power Platform's connector classification documentation instead lists Microsoft Copilot Studio as nonblockable by data policies.
claims.quote: The following connectors can't be blocked by using data policies. ... | Microsoft 365 Groups Mail (Preview) | Microsoft Copilot Studio |

claims.claim: The connector classification page says advanced connector policies can restrict these nonblockable connectors.
claims.quote: ACP uses a strict allowlist model and can restrict any certified connector, including the nonblockable connectors listed in this article.

claims.claim: A data policy governs Copilot Studio agents in the environments in its scope.
claims.quote: These data policies apply to Copilot Studio agents in the environments included in the policy's scope.

claims.claim: The environment credit route is Licensing > Products > Copilot Studio > Manage Copilot Credits > environment > Capacity overages > Draw from the available capacity in my tenant.
claims.quote: select Licensing. ... Under Products, select Copilot Studio, and then select Manage Copilot Credits. ... Select the environment ... Under Capacity overages, select or clear Draw from the available capacity in my tenant

claims.claim: PUT https://api.powerplatform.com/licensing/allocationsV2?api-version=2024-10-01 writes environment credit allocations.
claims.quote:
All programmatic examples in this article use API version `2024-10-01`. ... Invoke-RestMethod -Method Put `
    -Uri "$apiBaseUrl/licensing/allocationsV2?api-version=$apiVersion"

claims.claim: The request body's TenantPool enforcement rule controls drawing from tenant capacity.
claims.quote: The Draw from the available capacity in my tenant option in the admin center maps to the `TenantPool` enforcement rule

claims.claim: Clearing tenant-capacity draw leaves consumption limited to allocated prepaid credits unless pay-as-you-go is enabled.
claims.quote: If no overage source is enabled, the environment can consume only its allocated prepaid credits. Experiences that require credits can stop working after that allocation is exhausted.

claims.claim: The per-agent limit route is Licensing > Copilot Studio > Manage Agents > agent > Set limit > Stop usage.
claims.quote: go to Licensing > Copilot Studio. ... Select Manage Agents. ... Select the agent, and then select Set limit. ... Turn on Stop usage if the agent should be turned off when it reaches the limit.

claims.claim: Microsoft does not document how to use the Resource Threshold API for a Copilot Studio agent's monthly limit.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Studio agent monthly limit Resource Threshold API stopIfOverCapacity resourceId MCSMessages. Read Upsert Resource Threshold, Manage costs for agents, and capacity management; no agent mapping or monthly-limit procedure found.

claims.claim: The Resource Threshold API documents creating or updating a threshold for an environment resource.
claims.quote: Create or update the resource threshold for an environment resource.

claims.claim: Agent monthly limits are not applied instantly.
claims.quote: Limits aren't applied instantly. An agent can continue to respond for some time after it reaches its limit, so set limits and notification thresholds with some margin.

claims.where: controls[3].ui; Governance controls table; What it is: The run
claims.claim: In the Microsoft Copilot harness preview, makers open their agent, choose Evaluate, select an evaluation and select Evaluate to start it.
claims.quote: On the Evaluate tab, start a new evaluation. ... Select Evaluate to run the test and wait for the results.

claims.where: controls[3].api; Governance controls table; What it is: The run
claims.claim: The documented evaluation-start call is POST https://api.powerplatform.com/copilotstudio/environments/{EnvironmentId}/bots/{BotId}/api/makerevaluation/testsets/{TestSetId}/run?api-version=2024-10-01.
claims.quote: POST https://api.powerplatform.com/copilotstudio/environments/{EnvironmentId}/bots/{BotId}/api/makerevaluation/testsets/{TestSetId}/run?api-version=2024-10-01

claims.where: controls[3].note; What it is: harness distinction
claims.claim: The cited evaluation API documentation describes the standard harness.
claims.quote: This article describes features used in agents or agent flows powered by the standard harness.

claims.where: controls[4]; Governance controls table; Open questions
claims.claim: A dedicated tenant or environment switch turning agent evaluation off is not documented as of November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Studio agent evaluation disable tenant environment setting turn off evaluations; Copilot Studio evaluation tenant PowerShell disable. Read evaluation intro/results, data policy guidance and governance excerpts; no dedicated evaluation switch found.

claims.quote: Exact match | Whether agent answers match the expected response completely.
